definition: I. [ קָלַע ] verb sling, hurl forth ( Thes compare Arabic sit insecurely (see also Frä 224 , Socin in Buhl Lex 13 ), waver , whence sail (loan-word Frä l.c .), Jewish-Aramaic קַלְעָא id. , Biblical Hebrew Late Hebrew קֶלַע curtain ; thence hurl, sling ; but this perhaps denominative ( Soc l.c .) from loosened clod , compare Syriac id. ( Nö in Frä l.c .); Arabic sling , Eth : id. ; ᵑ7 קְלַע verb sling , Syriac noun sling ); — Qal Participle קֹלֵעַ בָּאֶבֶן אֶלֿ Judg 20:16 one slinging ( with ) a stone at a hair; ׳ קוֺ with accusative of person Jer 10:18 I will sling forth the inhabitants. Pi`el Imperfect 3 masculine singular וַיִקַלַּע 1Sam 17:49 and he slang (that is, the stone); suffix יְקַלְּעֶנָּה 1Sam 25:29 he shall sling away (life of enemy).
